== Objectives ==
Enter Frostmane Hollow in Dun Morogh and acquire a flawless leopard pelt for Shandlar Thethis in Alah’thalas in the Thalassian Highlands. You can find the entrance to Frostmane Hollow near the Ironforge Airfields.
* [[Flawless Leopard Pelt]]

== Description ==
Ba’la dash, malanore. It has been brought to my attention that the deep caverns of Khaz Modan house a particular breed of snow leopards whose fur boasts a remarkable sheen of white. My lord, Astalor of House Sunsworn, requested a one-of-a-kind mantle for his upcoming dinner party and I intend to combine said white fur with the most pristine brocade cloth I have in my possession.

Adventurer, would you be interested in a job of the lucrative kind? If you bring me an immaculate leopard pelt from within Frostmane Hollow, then I will reward you with a fine piece from my current collection. Do we come to an agreement?

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* [[Thalassian Silk Cape]]
* 1250 XP

== Progress ==
Make haste, <class>. My liege is not known for his patience.

== Completion ==
The rumors were correct, rarely have I seen such a smooth and silky pelt before. I cannot wait to start working with it. As promised, a reward for you as well. I am sure you will find ample use for it.
